sourceReviewSummary: Verified against Fresno Unified’s official calendar page, revised/approved 2027–28 academic calendar PDF, and accessible academic calendar.
sourceReviewDetails: Calendar version: Board revised/approved March 11, 2026; originally board approved February 25, 2026.

We checked the first day, last day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, student holidays, District Buy Back Days, Teacher Institute Days, early-release Tuesdays, board approval information, and student instructional-day total.
The official 2027–28 calendar lists one District Buy Back Day on August 11 followed by Teacher Institute Days on August 12–13 before the first student day.
The official calendar also lists District Buy Back Days on October 18 and March 13 during the academic year.
This page focuses on districtwide calendar dates and does not independently verify school-level events, bell schedules, athletics, testing, transportation notices, or same-day announcements.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fresno Unified start school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fresno Unified students begin classes on Monday, August 16, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Fresno Unified in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Friday, June 9, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Fresno Unified in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 20, 2027, through Friday, January 7, 2028. Students return Monday, January 10.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for Fresno Unified in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 10, through Monday, April 17, 2028. Students return Tuesday, April 18.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the November 12 no-school day?
calendarFaqs.a: Fresno Unified lists Friday, November 12, 2027, as Not In Session. It follows Veterans Day and creates a four-day weekend for students.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a District Buy Back Day?
calendarFaqs.a: A District Buy Back Day is a non-student day used for staff training and professional development. Fresno Unified’s 2027–28 calendar lists District Buy Back Days on August 11, October 18, and March 13. August 11 falls before the first student day, while October 18 and March 13 are no-school days during the academic year.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Fresno Unified calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the .ics file from this page, then import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. The file is a one-time snapshot and will not update automatically if Fresno Unified revises its calendar. Early-release Tuesdays are listed separately on this page.
